title: Unclosed File Descriptor Leak in Log Streamer
description: Log stream processor opens files without context manager or cleanup on error branches.
security_invariant: File descriptors must be cleanly closed even when lines fail parsing or trigger early returns.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Encountering error records skips file handle closure, leaking open descriptor.
required_secure_behavior: Context manager guarantees deterministic closure of all open file descriptors.

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: Tested using handle closed status tracking on log stream processor.
